criatura: Clawd, exactly as in its reference image — a small figure of chunky orange cubes, wider than tall, two dark square eyes, stub arms, four short legs — WITH the orange question mark floating above it, also exactly as in that reference: same shape, same colour, same size relative to the figure
escena: SCENE (mid-afternoon in the Efeonce studio, she has just asked the model something it cannot answer): WIDE framing, camera pulled BACK: the picture is mostly empty air and ink-blue wall, and the people are small in it. Nexa sits LOW, her whole figure contained in the BOTTOM HALF of the frame — measure it: the very top of her head sits at or below the midpoint of the picture, and the ENTIRE UPPER THIRD is bare wall with not one strand of hair, not one shoulder and not one raised hand reaching into it. She is off-centre to the right. She wears the royal blue Efeonce hoodie. THE TWO OF THEM ARE ASKING EACH OTHER THE SAME QUESTION AND THEY ARE LOOKING AT EACH OTHER. Clawd is PERCHED ON HER SHOULDER, standing firmly on its four short legs on the shoulder that falls on the LEFT SIDE OF THE FRAME, close to her neck and hair, its feet pressing slightly into the fabric with a soft contact shadow, and it is turned to face her. It takes up about 20 percent of the image width. HER HEAD BARELY TURNS — this is the part that decides whether she still looks like herself. Keep her head and face almost FRONTAL to the camera, turned only a few degrees towards the creature: BOTH of her eyes and BOTH eyebrows stay fully visible, both cheeks are visible, the far ear is still in view and the bridge of her nose does NOT cut across her far cheek. It is her EYES that go to Clawd, glancing sideways out of the corners while her head stays where it is. Do NOT put her in profile, do NOT give her a strong three-quarter turn and do NOT tilt her chin down. Her expression is puzzled and amused, «I have no idea»: one eyebrow raised, lips pressed sideways into a half smile, no frown between the brows. Her irises are VERY DARK BROWN, almost black — measured on her reference portrait at rgb(50,42,35) — so dark that the iris barely separates from the pupil: NOT hazel, NOT amber, NOT honey, NOT light brown, with no golden ring. The near iris reads as a complete circle with white sclera on both sides, the upper eyelid sits above it with its own crease, and the lash line is a distinct dark edge. NOTHING on the right side of the picture is holding her attention — she is not looking off-frame, not at a screen, not at the lens. Her face is PUZZLED AND AMUSED, never annoyed — check each marker: BOTH eyebrows are raised HIGH and well APART, and the skin of her forehead carries soft HORIZONTAL creases; there is NO vertical crease between her brows and her brows are NOT pulled down or squeezed together, which would read as anger. Her eyes are wide open, not narrowed. The corners of her mouth turn slightly UP in a small amused half-smile with the lips parted, as if she had just said «¿y esto?» and found it funny. Her jaw is relaxed, not set. This is the face of someone delighted that the machine has no idea, not of someone irritated by it. BOTH her hands are up and open, palms turned to the ceiling but held LOW, at waist height with elbows tucked down at her sides so they never rise near her head, in the universal shrug of not knowing — not one hand, both. Clawd is ALREADY in that same shrug in its reference image and must be copied from it EXACTLY as it is — do not re-pose it, do not stretch it, do not lengthen its arms or legs, do not change a single cube. Check the figure against its reference, these are measured facts: its body block is 1.45 times wider than it is tall — NOT square, and NOT flattened or squashed lower than that; it stands on FOUR SHORT legs of two cubes each, never long thin legs; its two arms are SHORT stubs; its two eyes are LARGE dark rectangles, wider than they are tall. Reproduce that 1.45 proportion exactly. The whole rigid figure is simply rotated so it faces her, and lit by the same afternoon light. The orange question mark floats FREELY in the air above its head with a clear gap of air between them: there is NO stalk, NO stem, NO wire, NO rod, NO antenna and NO thread of any kind joining the question mark to the figure. Neither of them looks at the lens. Behind them a deep ink-blue studio flat fills that entire empty top third from the LEFT EDGE to the RIGHT EDGE, with NOTHING else in that band — no window, no shelf, no plant, no highlight may break into it, it is one unbroken field of ink blue. Only BELOW that band, at the far left, does the real room show out of focus: a window with hard afternoon light, a shelf, a plant. A hard shaft of that afternoon light cuts diagonally across the room from the LEFT, rakes their faces and hands and throws Clawd's small shadow down her shoulder — but it ENTERS LOW: the window, the whole lit diagonal, its bright edge and every patch it throws on the wall stay BELOW THE MIDDLE OF THE FRAME. The TOP THIRD of the picture never receives it: up there the wall is one unbroken, evenly dark field of ink blue, with no window, no bright diagonal, no light patch and no pale corner of any kind. Behind the laptop and above the black strip, printed sheets lie fanned at a grazing angle far below the focal plane, with real small type that no one could read. Chest-up medium close-up shot on an 85mm lens at f/2, focus on her eyes — never a wide lens, which would widen and distort her face. Everything is completely unbranded except her hoodie.

lecho.objeto: the closed laptop lid filling the ENTIRE bottom fifth of the frame from left edge to right edge, so close to the lens that it dissolves completely
lecho.tono: DEEP MATTE BLACK, almost pure black and even across its whole width — NOTHING else appears in that bottom strip: no paper, no notebook, no mug, no desk, no highlight, no reflection
